- **self**: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints (14/3)

## Definitions

- [statement] ELEVATE_RESUMABLE is a database-scoped default available from SQL Server 2019: OFF is the default, WHEN_SUPPORTED elevates eligible operations and lets unsupported ones run nonresumably, and FAIL_UNSUPPORTED rejects unsupported execution within its scope. Configure it with ALTER DATABASE SCOPED CONFIGURATION SET ELEVATE_RESUMABLE = WHEN_SUPPORTED. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-20) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/statements/alter-database-scoped-configuration-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/indexes/guidelines-for-online-index-operations?view=sql-server-ver17, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/sql-server/blog/2018/05/08/database-scoped-default-online-options-is-in-preview-for-azure-sql-db/

## How it works

- [statement] ELEVATE_RESUMABLE affects only DDL supporting RESUMABLE syntax when the statement omits that option. Explicit RESUMABLE = OFF overrides even FAIL_UNSUPPORTED; XML index operations are outside the setting. Treat this as a default, not an unconditional enforcement policy. (high confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/statements/alter-database-scoped-configuration-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/indexes/guidelines-for-online-index-operations?view=sql-server-ver17, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/485976/sql-server-2019-elevate-online-and-elevate-resumab
- [statement] Database defaults can make eligible index DDL resumable without an explicit RESUMABLE clause. Brent Ozar demonstrates why callers must account for retained paused work when cancelling such DDL. (medium confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/statements/alter-database-scoped-configuration-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://www.brentozar.com/archive/2019/03/what-happens-when-you-cancel-or-kill-a-resumable-index-creation/

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Enable resumable constraint creation with WITH (ONLINE = ON, RESUMABLE = ON). MAX_DURATION specifies minutes until automatic pause; if omitted, execution continues to completion. (high confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://www.mssqltips.com/sqlservertip/7618/pause-and-resume-creation-of-table-constraints-in-sql-server/, https://www.sqltabletalk.com/?p=1162, https://www.mafiree.com/blog/sql-server-2022-resumable-alter-table

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Microsoft's constraint documentation shows manual PAUSE disconnecting the original session with error 1219, followed by error 1750, while the operation remains PAUSED in sys.index_resumable_operations. (low confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints
- [statement] A failed constraint build can remain paused. MSSQLTips demonstrates a duplicate-key failure followed by error 10637 on attempted constraint removal; inspect sys.index_resumable_operations and explicitly ABORT work that should be discarded. (medium confidence) — https://www.mssqltips.com/sqlservertip/7618/pause-and-resume-creation-of-table-constraints-in-sql-server/ · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Resumable constraint creation can continue after maintenance-window pauses, failovers or system failures rather than restarting all work. (medium confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://www.mafiree.com/blog/sql-server-2022-resumable-alter-table, https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/amazon-rds-for-sql-server-now-supports-sql-server-2022/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] ELEVATE_RESUMABLE is documented for SQL Server 2019 and later, Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance; it supplies a database-scoped resumable default for eligible DDL. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-06) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/statements/alter-database-scoped-configuration-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/indexes/guidelines-for-online-index-operations?view=sql-server-ver17
- [statement] SQL Server 2022 adds resumable ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT for PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE constraints, excluding FOREIGN KEY constraints; execution requires ONLINE = ON. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-11-18) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://www.mafiree.com/blog/sql-server-2022-resumable-alter-table, https://www.mssqltips.com/sqlservertip/7618/pause-and-resume-creation-of-table-constraints-in-sql-server/
- [statement] Manage resumable constraint creation with ALTER INDEX ALL ON <table> PAUSE, RESUME or ABORT; inspect progress using sys.index_resumable_operations. (high confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://www.mafiree.com/blog/sql-server-2022-resumable-alter-table, https://www.mssqltips.com/sqlservertip/7618/pause-and-resume-creation-of-table-constraints-in-sql-server/
- [statement] AWS announced that Amazon RDS for SQL Server 2022 supports pausing and resuming ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT, including recovery after failovers or system failures. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-11-16) — https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/amazon-rds-for-sql-server-now-supports-sql-server-2022/ · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints
- [statement] Microsoft requires ALTER permission on the table and specifies no new permission for resumable ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT. (low confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints
- [statement] The database-scoped configuration reference documents PAUSED_RESUMABLE_INDEX_ABORT_DURATION_MINUTES with a 1,440-minute default and zero disabling automatic abort; verify platform support and actual configuration before assuming indefinite retention. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-06) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/t-sql/statements/alter-database-scoped-configuration-transact-sql?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints
- [statement] Monitor constraint creation through sys.index_resumable_operations using sql_text, state_desc and percent_complete. The catalog documents total_execution_time in minutes and state values 0 for running and 1 for paused. (high confidence) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/security/resumable-add-table-constraints?view=sql-server-ver17 · keywords: SQL Server resumable index operations: ELEVATE_RESUMABLE and resumable constraints · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/relational-databases/system-catalog-views/sys-index-resumable-operations?view=sql-server-ver17
